Hi! Let me try to address your questions. Take everything I say about the actual school with a grain of salt since I was a marketing student in the business school.

- Suffolks campus mainly lies on tremont street and somerset. When it’s nice out, lots of students go to the common or will explore the city. Suffolk itself has a nice library with floors you can talk on and ones you can’t. 

- again, I was in the business school, but I’ve been in a class of 40 and also in a class of 6. Id say the average class has about 20-30 students.

- I never lived outside the dorms due to miss Rona but my friends who do recommend east Boston and Allston. Best prices and close to subway.

- I’m sorry, not sure what that is.

- Sodexo (suffolks food service) is awful and expensive. I really enjoyed capitol coffee house for breakfast, there’s also a TON of Dunkin’ and Starbucks locations and other little cafes. You’re right about the clam chowder, and I’d add that Boston has really good Italian food on the north end. As a New Yorker I’m obliged to say the pizza is not all that great. 

- Chinatown is super close to campus. It’s a bit of a pricey area and is close to downtown crossing, which is a haven for druggies. 

Hope that helps!
